assessment: The historical journey creates a bookmark from a PDF text selection and then deletes it. The current delete test starts from a seeded bookmark, so it does not prove the create-then-delete journey.
followUp: Add a self-contained user-level create-from-text-selection then delete contract.

assessment: The current rename test starts from an API-seeded bookmark. It does not prove the historical selection, creation and subsequent update sequence.
followUp: Add a self-contained user-level create-from-text-selection then rename contract.

scenario: Add a bookmark to a highlighted phrase on the PDF
playwrightContract: creates a bookmark from a real text selection
assessment: The replacement performs a real PDF text selection, uses the contextual bookmark action and asserts the bookmark POST payload and rendered bookmark list.

scenario: Check whether the comments panel is disappearing or not?
playwrightContract: opens and closes the comments panel with the seeded comment rendered
assessment: The replacement opens the panel, proves seeded comment rendering and toggles it closed, asserting both visible and hidden states.

playwrightContract: keeps a comment on a selected PDF highlight through rotation and rehydration
assessment: The replacement creates a PDF text highlight from a real selection, adds a comment to the selected annotation and proves the comment after rotation and reload.

scenario: Show And Hide the Comments Panel
assessment: The historical steps combine comments-search no-result behaviour with panel navigation despite the scenario name. Current tests cover those behaviours separately, not as this one coherent journey.
followUp: Add one contract covering panel open, the comments search tab, a no-result search and panel close.

playwrightContract: collates rendered comments and returns to the panel
assessment: The replacement opens the comments summary, asserts both rendered comments and closes the summary back to the panel.

scenario: Verify whether the user able to download the document or not?
playwrightContract: hands the loaded PDF URL and configured filename to the browser download
assessment: The replacement uses the visible Download action and asserts the exact resolved document URL and configured filename handed to the browser.

scenario: Add Non Textual Highlight and add comment in image viewer
playwrightContract: creates a non-text image highlight and comment through the rendered Media Viewer
assessment: The replacement uses the rendered image draw gesture and comment flow, but the real image draw surface is currently not drawable; the contract is retained under EXUI-5124 and is not counted as green coverage.
followUp: Fix EXUI-5124, run the tagged contract, and require persisted geometry plus comment rehydration before changing this to covered.

scenario: Delete Non Textual comment in image viewer
playwrightContract: deletes a persisted non-text image comment
assessment: The replacement loads a seeded non-text image annotation, selects its rendered rectangle, deletes its comment and asserts the comment is absent.

scenario: Update Non Textual comment in image viewer
playwrightContract: updates a persisted non-text image comment
assessment: The replacement loads a seeded non-text image annotation, selects it, edits the comment and asserts replacement text rendering.

scenario: Check whether the audio player is working or not?
playwrightContract: plays, pauses and rewinds an audio fixture through the focused native player
assessment: The replacement loads the audio fixture, focuses the native player and asserts the playing state.

playwrightContract: plays, pauses and rewinds an audio fixture through the focused native player
assessment: Although the legacy title says Video, the historical steps assert audio pause. The replacement exercises audio pause state on the native player.

playwrightContract: plays, pauses and rewinds an audio fixture through the focused native player
assessment: The replacement exercises audio rewind through the user-facing player keyboard contract and asserts the current time moves backwards.

scenario: Check whether the video player is working or not?
assessment: The current native-player smoke contract proves controls exist but does not play a video and assert playing state.
followUp: Add a deterministic MP4 fixture contract proving video load and play state.

assessment: The current focused multimedia contract is audio-only; no current test proves a video pause transition.
followUp: Add a deterministic MP4 play-then-pause contract and assert paused state.

assessment: The current focused multimedia contract is audio-only; no current test proves a video rewind transition.
followUp: Add a deterministic MP4 play-then-rewind contract and assert currentTime decreases.

assessment: The current navigation test proves the toolbar is visible and page boundaries work, but does not exercise the historical toggle-button enablement contract.
followUp: Add a self-contained contract that enables each applicable toolbar toggle and asserts its enabled/expanded state.

playwrightContract: navigates a top-level outline document destination
assessment: The replacement opens the Index/outline panel, proves the top-level destination is visible, navigates through it and asserts the selected outline state and page.
No current contract opens the outline sidebar, selects Show Bookmarks and asserts the resulting bookmark list.
followUp: Add a self-contained outline Show Bookmarks contract with one created bookmark.

scenario: Add a comment to PDF Text highlight
playwrightContract: creates a text highlight from a real PDF selection and persists its rendered geometry
assessment: The historical executable steps stop at the text-highlight popup. The replacement performs the real selection and proves the persisted non-zero geometry, which covers that exercised behaviour.

playwrightContract: keeps a comment on a selected PDF highlight through rotation and rehydration
assessment: The replacement performs text selection, adds a comment to the selected annotation and proves the comment after rotation and rehydration.
The current delete contract does not identify or assert deletion of a seeded textual comment specifically.
followUp: Seed a textual annotation with a comment, select it in the UI, assert its DELETE request and prove the sibling annotation remains.

assessment: The current rotation/comment contract creates a comment but does not edit an existing PDF text comment and assert replacement text.
followUp: Add a real text-highlight create, comment edit and reload contract.

scenario: Add Non Textual Highlight and add comment in pdf viewer
playwrightContract: collates distinct text-selection and draw-box comments after rehydration
assessment: The replacement performs a real PDF draw-box gesture, adds a comment to the selected draw-box annotation and proves it in the panel and summary after reload.
The current generic rectangle deletion contract does not seed or identify a non-text annotation, so it cannot prove this historical disposition semantically.
followUp: Seed a draw-box annotation with a comment and assert user-level selection, deletion and retained siblings.

assessment: The current comments summary contract proves summary content and navigation but contains no ellipsis/truncation assertion for a long comment card.
followUp: Add a long-comment contract asserting the rendered ellipsis styling/content affordance.

scenario: Add multiple non-textual comments on PDF page
assessment: The current collation contract creates one text-selection and one draw-box comment. It does not prove multiple non-text comments on the same PDF page.
followUp: Add two independent draw-box comments on one page and assert both distinct comments in the panel.

scenario: Redacting text and then removing the redaction
playwrightContract: redacts selected text and removes the persisted marker
assessment: The replacement selects fixture text, asserts a saved redaction with positive geometry, deletes it through the UI and proves no marker remains.

scenario: Drawing a box and then removing it
playwrightContract: deletes one persisted marker while keeping its sibling redaction
assessment: The replacement creates two draw-box redactions, selects and deletes one, asserts the DELETE request and proves the sibling remains.

The current preview contract creates only a draw-box marker and then clears it; it does not create both text and box redactions or prove switching back from preview as the historical journey describes.
followUp: Add a combined text-and-box preview contract asserting preview rendering and return to editable mode.

scenario: Testing the save document with redactions button
assessment: The Viewer-owned save/download hand-off is covered elsewhere, but this historical scenario depends on a DM Store document and external AAT setup, which is outside this self-contained migration slice.
followUp: Keep the external DM Store/CCD journey in the separately owned external-service assurance scope if that boundary still requires evidence.

scenario: Testing the clear all redactions button
playwrightContract: downloads draw-box redactions, adds text redaction and clears all markers
assessment: The replacement exercises draw-box and text redactions, invokes clear all, asserts the DELETE request, empty markers and empty state after reload.

playwrightContract: hands the loaded PDF URL to the browser print window
assessment: The replacement invokes the visible Print action and asserts the exact loaded PDF URL handed to the browser print window.
The current rotation/comment contract proves a comment survives rotation, but it does not assert the text-highlight rectangle remains geometrically aligned with the rotated PDF text.
followUp: Add a seeded text-highlight geometry contract that compares annotation and PDF text-layer bounds before and after rotation.
